findings.comment: Building foundations and service line routing are shown on site plans, but no profile views or detail sheets document vertical clearance from underground electrical facilities to building foundation edges. Service connections run directly to building walls at multiple locations, but 5-foot horizontal clearance from foundation perimeters cannot be verified from available plans.

No canopies or overhangs are explicitly labeled on the electrical or site plans. Cannot verify clearance requirements without specific identification and dimension documentation of canopy/overhang foundations relative to electrical facilities.

applicableAreas: Site improvements and hardscape throughout site
findings.comment: Courtyard areas, walkways, and hardscape features are shown on site and landscape plans, but no explicit clearance verification is documented between these features and underground electrical facilities. Electrical routing on site plan does not clearly indicate all facility locations at sufficient resolution to verify 5-foot clearances.

applicableAreas: Storm drain grate inlets throughout site
findings.comment: Storm sewer plan (Sheet 12) shows inlet locations but does not depict underground electrical facilities. Electrical plan (Sheet 21) shows electrical routing but does not show drain inlet locations. Overlay of the two plans required to verify clearances; cannot be verified from individual sheets.

applicableAreas: Water line crossings with electric conduit
findings.comment: Sheet 19 (Utility Tap Plan) shows water and wastewater routing but does not depict electrical lines. Sheet 21 (Electrical Plan) shows electrical routing but does not show water lines. No profile sheets provided showing vertical or horizontal clearances at crossing points. No detail callouts or dimensions document required 12-inch separation at perpendicular crossings.

applicableAreas: Wastewater line crossings with electric conduit
findings.comment: Sheet 19 shows wastewater routing but does not depict electrical lines. Sheet 21 shows electrical routing but does not show wastewater lines. No profile sheets showing vertical or horizontal clearances at crossing points. No detail callouts or dimensions document required 12-inch separation at perpendicular crossings.

applicableAreas: Storm drain crossings with electric conduit
findings.comment: Sheet 12 (Storm Sewer Plan) shows storm drain routing but does not depict electrical facilities. Sheet 21 shows electrical routing but does not show storm drain lines. No profile sheets showing vertical or horizontal clearances at crossing points. No detail callouts or dimensions document required 12-inch separation.

Utility plans and profiles do not show complete coordination between all utilities. Sheet 20 (Water Profile) does not show electrical line profile. No profile sheets provided showing vertical clearances (1-foot minimum) at locations where water or wastewater lines cross underground electrical facilities.

Electrical plan (Sheet 21) shows underground electric facilities and identifies some utilities but communication conduit routing is not clearly depicted or labeled on the available utility plans. Cannot verify whether communication conduits are or are not routed over AE main line duct banks without explicit identification of communication conduit routing.

No detail sheets provided showing 2-inch concrete encasement requirements at utility crossings. Sheet 20 (Water Profile) shows a gas crossing at Sta 0+43 but no encasement detail is referenced or shown. No coordination documentation provided verifying that AE Design approval or specific encasement requirements have been obtained for electrical-utility crossings.
